execution_prerequisite: P0 and P1 PASS on same execution commit before P2
scope: matched synthetic model; not FFD, hardware, or independent scene validation
primary_contrast: MAP4 minus MAP3 trial heading MSE at true bias +0.05 deg/s; each of three predefined paths

path_controls.return: v=0.20 m/s before t=30; v=-0.20 afterwards; omega=0 (reverse driving, not a turn-around manoeuvre)

gate: OFF for all models in this declared matched Gaussian experiment only; this does not authorize removing gates in real RF experiments
analysis_window: all 120 post-update time points, t=0.5 to 60 s
primary_decision: 95% percentile CI upper<0: SUPPORT; lower>0: CONTRADICTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Any non-SUPPORT blocks scientific progression pending analysis and confirmation.
numerical_decision: Any solver nonconvergence, nonfinite state/metric, covariance failure, or trace reconstruction mismatch blocks continuation; never silently replace a failed update by prediction.
coverage_note: fixed true bias conditional repeated-trial coverage, not unconditional prior-predictive calibration
preserve: all generated inputs, truth-for-scoring, all model states/covariances per trial, numerical failure snapshot, trial metrics, contrasts, config/source/output hashes
